name: regulatory-legal
description: Regulatory monitoring, policy gap analysis, NPRM response drafting, and comment-letter tracking for compliance and government affairs teams.
author: Anthropic

skills.name: cold-start-interview
skills.description: Initial practice profile setup — learns your regulatory universe, agency dockets, and compliance calendar in 10-15 minutes

skills.name: reg-feed-watcher
skills.description: Monitor Federal Register, agency dockets, and state regulatory feeds for new rules, proposals, and guidance in your regulatory universe

skills.name: policy-diff
skills.description: Compare two versions of a regulation or policy document and surface material changes with legal significance

skills.name: gaps
skills.description: Map your current compliance posture against a new or amended regulation and surface gaps requiring remediation

skills.name: nprm-response
skills.description: Draft a notice-and-comment response to a proposed rulemaking keyed to your organization's positions

skills.name: comment-tracker
skills.description: Track the status of comment letters submitted, agency response timelines, and final rule publication dates
